doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: J. J. Johnson, Max Roach and Miles Davis join the band
summary: Carter recalls younger players, with Miles joining in St. Louis for a few weeks in 1946.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: You just mentioned that a lot of people were getting drafted. Was that the only reason these people came in, or did you want to inject a different kind of sound or you were attracted to some of these younger musicians?

No, but, I mean, some of those I replaced because they went into the service. But, no, I don’t know. Just, you know, J. J. Johnson joined me in Indianapolis [Indiana] and came to California with me. Now, when Max Roach came into the band, I don’t remember. Miles Davis was in the band in ’46, something, and he was with it for just a short time, maybe a matter of weeks.
You picked him up in St. Louis [Missouri], is that correct?
Oh, did I? I don’t remember.
No, I didn’t know whether I picked him up in St. Louis or he came here.
He joined me in St. Louis.
Well, he was from St. Louis. He was from East St. Louis, yeah.
